what: When a stamp or badge graphic is 30% in view (excluding the bottom 5%), it pops from .4x · −12° transparent over .55s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) up to 1.1x · 3°, passes through .95x · −1°, and thumps into place. look: down presses from 1.28x · −8° above down to .92x, then settles via 1.03 (section header logo). Plays once

options.look: down: Type that presses down from above (shrinks from large)
options.threshold: Share that must be visible, default .3 — .05 for large section backgrounds
